sections.title: The letter essz
paragraphs: The letter name is (essz) /ɛs/. Its main sound is heard in the word (szem) /ˈsɛm/, which means eye. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say essz
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your tongue tip near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap. The sound is voiceless, so your throat does not shake. Keep your throat quiet with your hand. For the second sound, keep the same mouth shape, but turn your voice on. The sound is voiced, so you feel your throat shake.

sections.title: Spelling of essz
paragraphs: In all standard positions, you hear the voiceless sound in (tavasz) /ˈtɒvɒs/. The sound changes before a voiced consonant because of voice assimilation. Voice assimilation is a change where one sound becomes more like the sound next to it. In that place, you hear the voiced sound in (részben) /ˈreːzbɛn/.

sections.title: Pitfalls with essz
paragraphs: Do not read this letter as the sound in shoe. It is never like the sh in English. Always say it as a clean hiss, like the s in sun. Keep your tongue close to the tooth ridge and never round your lips.
